//: WI-AF3.2/3.3 — which committed baselines are DEBT, what paying them down means,
and which are not debt at all. Finding F5: ~450 frozen units across 27 baselines,
none of which had moved since they were measured. A ratchet stops debt growing;
it never asks anyone to pay it.
THERE ARE NO DEADLINES HERE, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE. An earlier revision of this
file carried a review date per baseline. Those dates were invented by the agent
that wrote them — a fortnightly stagger starting seven weeks out — and stamped
with `owner: maintainer`, which recorded a guess as somebody else's commitment.
Only one baseline here has any paydown history to extrapolate from (file-size:
153 -> 92 over two months); mock-boundaries has exactly one commit, its own
creation, so no honest rate exists for it at any confidence.
What IS measurable is staleness: how long a baseline has gone unchanged, and how
big it currently is. `scripts/check-review-schedule.mjs --report` reports both
and .github/workflows/baseline-review.yml keeps one rolling issue up to date.
Debt that stops moving surfaces on its own, without anyone pretending to know
when it should have been finished.
ORDER matters and is grounded: `tracked` is listed worst-first by measured size
and reachability, which is a claim about this repo, not about a calendar.
EXEMPT is a claim that a baseline is not debt, and requires a reason. Vendored
upstream corpora and inventories of what exists are not things anyone should be
asked to drive to zero. Every manifest entry must appear in exactly one of
`tracked` or `exempt`, and every key here must name a real manifest entry.

tracked.scripts/mock-boundaries-baseline.json: zero — tests use the real store (setState/reset) or a recorded store-factory seam
tracked.scripts/command-error-baseline.json: zero — every command returns Result<T, CommandError>
tracked.scripts/type-aware-baseline.json: zero — every awaited promise is awaited and every async callback is passed somewhere that can await it. 152 violations at first measurement (2026-08-14), 132 of them no-floating-promises/no-misused-promises; these are unhandled-rejection defects, not style, so paying this down is bug-fixing rather than tidying
tracked..dependency-cruiser-known-violations.jso: down — each frozen edge either deleted or re-expressed through a plugins/shared seam
tracked.scripts/plugin-store-coupling-baseline.j: zero on every channel — options and seams, not ambient lookups
tracked.scripts/file-size-baseline.json: down — split files, lower the number; never raise
tracked.scripts/bespoke-buttons-baseline.json: down — each bespoke class converted to .vm-btn / .popup-icon-btn
tracked.scripts/extension-budget.json: down — per-edge licenses retired as plugins decouple
tracked.src/utils/markdownPipeline/__tests__/spe: down — each declared divergence fixed or ruled a deliberate dialect choice

exempt.scripts/shell-slots-baseline.json: An INVENTORY, not debt: the identity list of the surfaces App.tsx mounts. It should track reality, and reality has ~20 surfaces. Driving it to zero would mean an app with no UI.
exempt.scripts/i18n-untranslated-baseline.json: Already zero — the ~1,160-entry debt was paid. The gate exists to keep it there, so there is nothing to schedule.
exempt.scripts/i18nIdenticalAllowlist.ts: A permanent registry of genuinely untranslatable strings (runner labels, literal paths), each with a stated reason and checked for staleness in both directions. Not a number anyone should drive down.
exempt.src/utils/markdownPipeline/__tests__/spe: Vendored upstream conformance corpus — test DATA, not debt.
Vendored upstream corpus — XSS payloads that must keep being escaped.
Vendored corpus for the md→ProseMirror oracle.
exempt.scripts/baseline-review-schedule.json: The register itself. Its `tracked` list is an identity set the ratchet holds, but a register of registers is bureaucracy, not debt.
exempt.scripts/merge-drop-allowlist.json: Already zero (WI-DP1.1): both claims verified as real relocations and removed. The gate keeps it empty, so there is nothing left to schedule.
exempt.scripts/knip-baseline.json: Already zero (WI-DP1.2): all 75 warn-tier findings resolved. The gate keeps it at zero, so there is nothing left to schedule.
